For a five-person team, these are three relatively budget-friendly Gurugram options:

iWORKK Coworking Office Space — ₹35,000/month for 5 desks. Fully furnished and flexible; trade-off is a less premium address than Golf Course Road. 
Office Hub

A-14/15, DLF Phase 1 — ₹45,000/month for 5 coworking desks. Central location and lower commitment cost; private office is ₹60,000/month if privacy matters. 
Office Hub

Co-offiz: Coworking Space in Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram-58 — worth getting a quote if location and a more professional setup matter; expect pricing above the cheapest Udyog Vihar options.

Budget benchmark: Gurugram dedicated desks commonly run about ₹6,000–₹10,000/seat/month in Udyog Vihar, so negotiate for a 5-seat package.
